params.prompt: Traditional Rajasthani Phad scroll painting (phad), Marwar folk art: flat two-dimensional figures in strict profile, bold black outlines, saturated mineral pigments on cloth — deep red-ochre ground, indigo, turmeric yellow, white — dense storytelling composition with a decorative patterned border on all sides, stylized large-eyed figures, no perspective, no shading, aged hand-woven cloth texture showing through the paint. Absolutely no readable text, no letters, no writing, no inscriptions anywhere. A sick man lies flat on a woven cot in strict profile, thin and grey-faced, and on his chest sits one large stylized crab painted in dark indigo with bold claws gripping, walking sideways — while in the corner of the panel a black snake flees away out of the border. A woman in profile sits at the cot's head holding his hand. Red-ochre ground, the crab is the focus, its sideways menace decorative but unmistakable.
